title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Remainder
statement: Encode a pair of bit strings by doubling each bit of the first string, appending the separator $01$, and then appending the second string. Decode aligned pairs as specified by this encoding, taking a decoded component to be empty if parsing fails, and interpret each component as a binary numeral with its first bit least significant. The function sending the encoded input to the binary expansion of the first decoded value modulo the second decoded value is polynomial-time computable.
